data.narrative:
Sagar Defence Engineering is a Series A-stage defense and security company that has raised $25.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing—all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression modeling, using total capital raised as a valuation proxy, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying a valuation of $51M. Peer-median analysis across the 3 most directly comparable same-sector, same-stage companies yields a median valuation of $400M, though the peer set exhibits substantial dispersion (range: $125M to $4.0B), reflecting heterogeneous risk and market positioning within frontier-defense subsectors.

The blended analysis supports a valuation range of $43M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $225M. This wide range reflects genuine uncertainty: the stage-progression method anchors conservatively to deployed capital, while peer comparables suggest substantially higher valuations depending on technology differentiation and capital efficiency. Key uncertainties include the company's defensibility relative to peers, pathway to revenue, and whether the peer set's top-end valuations reflect durable competitive positioning or funding-cycle inflation in defense-tech markets.
